attributes.name: Savash
attributes.powers:
Savash is immune to the Electricity and Fire traits. All damage dealt by Savash is Fire damage.

Before you act, each character at your location is dealt 1 Fire damage.

After you act, if your check to defeat Savash had the Piercing or Slashing trait, Savash deals 1d4+1 Fire damage to you.
